uncited: Sample points along rays and predict $\mathbf{R}(\mathbf{r})$, $\mathbf{S}(\mathbf{r})$, and surface normals.
Compute the photometric reconstruction loss $\mathcal{L}$ and optional depth loss $\mathcal{L}_d$.
Compute the mean reflectance regularization $\mathcal{L}_{mean,r}$ by comparing the maximum RGB channel value of $\mathbf{R}(\mathbf{r})$ to $\beta_{avg,r}$.
Compute the shading smoothness loss $\mathcal{L}_s$ as the variance of $\mathbf{S}(\mathbf{r})$ across the batch.
Compute the shading-normal consistency loss $\mathcal{L}_{sn}$ by weighting the absolute shading difference between point pairs by their normal cosine similarity and distance.
Not necessary for standard novel view synthesis where only photometric accuracy matters.
